currentFirst.method: Sequential Release harnesses, warm file cache, three pass/pipeline repetitions, up to 16 largest functions; 5ms OS peak-working-set sampling. Five fresh CLI processes including startup. No inspected sample executes. No UI latency, GPU, or wakeup inference.
